title: Tumbwe residents' protest over compensation for fields polluted/spoiled by Tumbwe Golden Mining
reason: Opened ACP report says protest targeted unpaid compensation by a private mining company, not a demonstrated state-policy demand. Police guarding the firm reportedly shot two residents; that state-force consequence does not change the private grievance target.

title: October nationwide and provincial teachers' strikes/school stoppages
reason: Sources document strikes, school closures and a union decision assembly, but do not establish a qualifying public gathering of at least fifty at a same-site public protest. Kalemie student march and Mbuji-Mayi teacher march are kept as separate candidate records.
